Pre-orders are now flying on the new iPhone 18 Pro, AirPods 5, Apple Watch Ultra 4, and Apple Watch Series 12, and we are tracking some deals on some of them. Joining the ongoing $50 price drop on AirPods Pro 3 and AirTag 2 back down at $20 each, today’s 9to5Toys Lunch Break is headlined by M5 MacBook Air up to $150 off at Amazon as well the lowest price ever on the most affordable 2026 Apple Studio Display. However we also have some notable deals on some of Anker’s latest MagSafe chargers from your new iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods: the 25W 3-in-1 Smart Display Charging Station at 40% off and the 25W 3-in-1 Foldable MagSafe Charger at up to 35% off. All of that and more awaits below.

Apple’s new AirPods 5 with ANC are live at $129, but this AirPods Pro 3 deal might be a better buy

We are heading into a new work week with AirPods Pro 3 still down at $199 ($50 off). The all-new AirPods 5 are now up for pre-order ahead of delivery this Friday, but we wanted to make sure this deal was on the radar – you can still land the flagship Pro 3 for just $50 more than the higher-end AirPods 5.

This generation Apple has decided to deliver active noise cancellation on both AirPods 5 models. For AirPods 4, only the higher-end set had ANC.

That means the starting price for Apple AirPods with ANC is just $129. And after seeing price increases on loads of tech, this seems rather impressive.

That said, if you want the on-stem volume controls and wireless charging case like the still current-gen AirPods Pro 3, you’ll need to jump up to the higher-end AirPods 5 at $149.

There is, of course, some additional differences between the top-end AirPods 5 and AirPods Pro 3 – mainly the sealed fit for Apple’s best sound isolation, up to 3x better noise cancellation, onboard heart sensing, and longer battery life.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $199 (Reg. $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $449 (Reg. $549)
  • AirPods 5 $129
  • AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case $149

Some folks simply prefer Apple’s more open and affordable AirPods 5-like design over the Pro series, and you can certainly score them for less ahead of delivery day this week. But it is worth keeping in mind that with the ongoing $50 price drop on AirPods Pro 3 at Amazon, they are only $50 and $70 more than the entry set right now. And there’s no telling how much longer this deal will last.

iPhone 18 Pro pre-order deals: Options from $867, under $12 per month, more

The iPhone 18 Pro is going up for pre-order this morning. Just after AirPods 5, Apple Watch Ultra 4, and Apple Watch Series 12 went live live alongside the ongoing discount on AirPods Pro 3, you will be able to secure Apple’s latest and greatest iPhone 18 Pro is starting from $32 per month on major carriers or $1,199 all-in unlocked. However, Walmart is also featuring some options for much less than that via T-Mobile starting at $867 + $11.85 per month on iPhone 18 Pro.

You’ll want to head straight to Apple if you’re taking the unlocked or trade-in route of course, but there are some other options out there this morning. More details below.

iPhone 18 Pro pre-orders deals now live

Walmart is serving up some notable monthly options this year for pre-order day if you’re looking to side-step the pricey unlocked rates straight from Apple:

  • iPhone 18 Pro from $32 per month | AT&T
  • iPhone 18 Pro Max from $34 per month | AT&T
  • iPhone 18 Pro Max from $34 per month | Verizon

As mentioned above Walmart is also featuring some options from T-Mobile that can secure you the new iPhone 18 Pro at much lower monthly rates:

  • iPhone 18 Pro $12 per month + $867 down | T-Mobile
  • iPhone 18 Pro Max $32 per month + $937 down | T-Mobile

For those going straight to Apple for the unlocked pre-order options, the new iPhone 18 Pro starts at $1,199 and the 18 Pro Max comes in at $1,299:

  • iPhone 18 Pro $1,199
  • Black, Burgundy, Glacier, and Silver
  • iPhone 18 Pro $1,299
  • Apple Watch Series 12 42mm $399
  • Apple Watch Series 12 46mm $449
  • Apple Watch Series 12 42mm GPS + Cell $490 (Reg. $499)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 46mm GPS + Cell $540 (Reg. $549)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 42mm Titanium $699
  • Apple Watch Series 12 42mm Titanium $729 (Reg. $749)
    • With Natural Milanese Loop
  • Apple Watch Series 12 46mm Titanium $729
  • Apple Watch Series 12 46mm Ceramic $949

Apple’s all-new AirPods 5 now available for pre-order from $129

Midnight M5 MacBook Air up to $150 off at Amazon (Likely won’t last long)

Update: As expected, the 15-inch model below has jumped up in price already, but there are some solid deals live on the 13-inch models now:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,649 (Reg. $1,799)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,449 (Reg. $1,599)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,199 (Reg. $1,299)

Joining the ongoing M6 Mac mini pre-orders, as well as the new AirPods 5, Apple Watch Ultra 4, and Apple Watch Series 12, this morning Amazon is kicking the week off with a solid $150 price drop on this Midnight 16GB M5 MacBook Air.

Amazon is now offering the 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB of RAM and the 1TB storage capacity down at $1,649 shipped.

Most affordable current-gen iPad Air now $100 off at Amazon

While this week it’s all about iPhone 18 Pro, AirPods 5, Apple Watch Ultra 4, and Apple Watch Series 12, we are catching a relatively rare chance to score the most affordable current-generation iPad Air at $100 off.

Amazon is now offering the 128GB 11-inch M4 iPad Air in a couple different colors down at $649 shipped. Regularly $749, this is $100 off and the lowest price can find. You’ll also find the 256GB 11-inch model in Gray down at $749.99 shipped on Amazon – this is just shy of $100 off and also the best deal we can find right now.

Both storage capacity options are, more or less, at the lowest prices we have tracked since the price increases back in late June. The 128GB gray model has dropped down a touch lower than this, but only for extremely short periods of time – you have had to be incredibly lucky and fast to score one for any lower than this since July.

As mentioned above, most eyes in the Apple world are zeroed in on the new iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods 5 right now. We have detailed some chances at savings on all of them now, and you’ll find the details below alongside some additional Apple discounts

Apple’s most affordable 2026 Studio Display just hit its best price ever

While we spotted the return all-time low at $330 off on the higher-end XDR model this morning, Amazon just dropped the price again on the most affordable 2026 Apple Studio Display to deliver the best deal ever at $115 off.

Amazon is now offering Apple’s 2026 Apple Studio Display with the Tilt-Adjustable Stand down at $1,484 shipped.

While certainly not as deep a deal as the XDR model we had at $330 off (or the Apple refurb listing at $500 off), this is a dramatically less expensive Studio Display model that still delivers a premium viewing experience to a workstation near you at the lowest price we have ever tracked.

All-time low pricing returns on AirTag 2 today at $20 each

Pre-orders are flying on the new AirPods 5, Apple Watch Ultra 4, and Apple Watch Series 12 (Amazon already has some deals too), but the AirTag 2 deals are back again today as well. After jumping back up close to full price over the last couple days, Amazon has decided to bring back all-time low pricing on Apple’s 2026 AirTag 2 at $20 each.

The single AirTag 2 listing has remained down at $24 Prime shipped for a few weeks now – this is matching the lowest price we have tracked for one of them in new condition at Amazon.

The 4-pack, however, is now sitting back down at $79.99 shipped– that’s $20 per AirTag 2.

  • AirTag 2 $24 (Reg. $29) – Matching all-time low
  • AirTag 2 4-pack $80 (Reg. $99) – Matching all-time low

Anker’s 25W 3-in-1 Smart Display Charging Station is iPhone 18 Pro-ready and 40% off today

Alongside the morning’s return low on is 25W 3-in-1 Foldable model, Anker’s official Amazon storefront has also dropped the price on its Smart Display-equipped Prime 3-in-1 Qi2.2 MagSafe Charging Station – it is now up to 41% off.

The official Anker Amazon storefront is now offering its Prime 3-in-1 Qi2.2 MagSafe 25W Wireless Charging Station down at $134.95 shipped in white, while the Phantom Gray model is sitting down at $139.98 shipped.

This premium charging solution carries a $230 list price and is now up to 41% off in white or just shy of 40% off on the sort of Space Gray-like colorway.

Anker’s 25W 3-in-1 Foldable MagSafe Charger back to Amazon all-time low at 35% off

The all-new iPhone 18 Pro is now live for pre-order alongside Apple Watch Series 12 and the ongoing AirPods Pro 3 deal, but this morning we are also tracking another shot at Amazon all-time low pricing on my favorite 3-in-1 foldable MagSafe charger for them all. Anker’s Prime 25W Qi2.2-certified 3-in-1 Foldable MagSafe Charger is now 35% off at Amazon.

The official Anker Amazon store is now offering its 3-in-1 Prime 25W Qi2.2 Foldable MagSafe Charger down at $99.73 shipped.

Regularly $150, this is over $50 off the list price, or nearly 35% in savings, to deliver the lowest price we can find. This is also on par with the best deal we have tracked at Amazon since release earlier this year.

SANDMARC debuts new leather and metal iPhone 18 Pro camera cases [Exclusive deal]

SANDMARC is a brand well known for its camera lens attachments for iPhoneographers, and it is very much one of the best in the game there. However, the cases those lens attachments connect to, especially the Pro Leather Case, are easily some of my personal favorite.

  • SANDMARC Pro Leather Case for iPhone 18 Pro $54 (Reg. $60)
    • Using code 9TO510 at checkout
  • SANDMARC Pro Leather Case for iPhone 18 Pro Max $54 (Reg. $60)

    ****Note: SANDMARC gear traditionally only goes on sale once per year for a few days during Black Friday….unless you have our exclusive discount code.

    First discount hits Apple’s new 24GB M6 Mac mini ahead of delivery this month

    Alongside the rest of the new lineup and the ongoing Amazon Labor Day sale, we are now tracking the very first discount on the brand new M6 Mac mini with 24GB of RAM.

    Amazon is now offering Apple’s brand new M6 Mac mini with 24GB of RAM and the 512GB SSD down at $1,269.99 shipped.

    While clearly not a massive discount or anything, this is the very lowest price this machine has been offered for since it went up for pre-order last week. And now, ahead of delivery on September 22, Amazon is offering the lowest price anywhere. All things considered, if you’re going to be pre-ordering the 24GB model – as a long-time Mac mini user, this is the best option if you ask me – you might as well save some gas and coffee or lunch money while you do it.

    As mentioned above, this model also joins a host of pre-order discounts the rest of the M6 Mac mini configurations Amazon carries, as well as the M5 Pro model:

    • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/256GB $880 (Reg. $899)
    • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB $1,070 (Reg. $1,099)
    • 2026 Mac mini M5 Pro 24GB/512GB $1,669 (Reg. $1,699)
